subtitle: A private, fee-gated cove on Montego Bay's Jimmy Cliff Boulevard where a doctor's 1906 land donation and a surgeon's 1920s magazine article built Montego Bay's health-tourism trade.
spike_statement: A Montego Bay doctor donated this cove in 1906; a British surgeon's 1920s article on its water's "curative" power helped make Montego Bay a tourist destination.

levers.photo_tone: A reef-sheltered crescent cove, glassy turquoise water inside the point, white clubhouse roofline and a lifeguard chair set against the traffic and hotel signage of Jimmy Cliff Boulevard behind it.
